articles.summary: Organizers are calling for one of the biggest demonstrations yet, in a string of rallies that has racked India since the summer.
articles.title: India’s Congress Party Plans Mass Protest in New Delhi

articles.summary: At a Halloween event in Florida, President Trump told reporters that Alina Habba Mildon’s lucrative work for someone seeking a pardon was “not acceptable.”
articles.title: Trump Calls Former Lawyer’s $50 Million Deal ‘Obnoxious and Outrageous’

articles.summary: Tensions have flared between Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic Senate nominee in Michigan, and his former primary rival. “I don’t want any distractions,” Dr. El-Sayed said Saturday.
articles.title: El-Sayed’s Campaign Doesn’t Want Haley Stevens at His Events
